capabilities: Create revision notes from pasted tab-separated label/value/unit columns
Normalize mm, cm, and in values to millimetres
Compare two revisions and compute delta mm and delta percent
Save a separate comparison report note without altering source files
Validate the JSON revision block in the active note
extras: Mobile operation and native installation are unverified despite isDesktopOnly: false; the README recommends installing into a test vault first and notes the community directory review is pending.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record sewing measurements across revisions and compare them with unit normalization and persistent change reports.
summary: Sewing measurement tool that stores measurement revisions as JSON notes and compares two revisions with unit normalization and a saved change report.
